trials.claim: Instantly extracts text from images, PDFs, slides, Zoom calls and YouTube videos
trials.claimQuote: TextSniper is a simple and easy to use OCR (Optical Character Recognition) app that helps instantly extract text from images, PDFs, slides, Zoom calls, or even YouTube videos.
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes instantly capturing non-selectable text from YouTube videos, PDFs, images, presentations and similar sources; complaints about misreading symbols do not contradict that instant capture capability.

exhibits.quote: TextSniper is great for normal text, but can have misreads when there are a lot of symbols such as you might find in computer code.
exhibits.argument: Quote admits OCR is not instant/perfect and misreads symbol-heavy text, undermining instantly extracts claim.

exhibits.quote: It suddenly inserts things that are in a line below into another text part, just as if at the end of a sentence, for example, only one word is there.
exhibits.argument: Review reports text is scrambled and not 1-to-1, contradicting reliable instant extraction.

exhibits.quote: Instantly capture non-selectable text from YouTube videos, PDFs, images, online courses, screencasts, presentations, webpages, video tutorials, photos, etc. It's so simple and easy as taking a screenshot with a built-in snipping tool for Mac.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes instantly capturing text from YouTube videos, PDFs and images as claimed.

trials.claimQuote: TextSniper is a simple and easy to use OCR (Optical Character Recognition) app that helps instantly extract text from images, PDFs, slides, Zoom calls, or even YouTube videos.
trials.reasoning: The vendor explicitly lists PDFs among the sources from which TextSniper instantly captures text.

exhibits.quote: I dont understand, why I cannot simply add already made screenshots.
exhibits.argument: Review shows PDFs/screenshots cannot be directly imported and must be re-screenshotted, undermining PDF extraction claim.

exhibits.quote: TextSniper is great for normal text, but can have misreads when there are a lot of symbols such as you might find in computer code.
exhibits.argument: Vendor admits misreads on non-normal text, undermining reliable PDF text extraction.

exhibits.quote: Instantly capture non-selectable text from YouTube videos, PDFs, images, online courses, screencasts, presentations, webpages, video tutorials, photos, etc. It's so simple and easy as taking a screenshot with a built-in snipping tool for Mac.
exhibits.argument: Vendor explicitly lists PDFs among sources for text capture, supporting PDF extraction.

trials.claim: Can extract text from Zoom calls
trials.claimQuote: TextSniper is a simple and easy to use OCR (Optical Character Recognition) app that helps instantly extract text from images, PDFs, slides, Zoom calls, or even YouTube videos.
trials.reasoning: The prosecution reviews complain generally about re-screenshotting and inaccurate ordering, but neither exhibit specifically addresses extracting text from Zoom calls and no defense exhibit confirms it.

exhibits.quote: I have several screenshots on my computer that I would have to open, make another screenshot from so that the app can extract the text.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows extraction requires manual re-screenshotting of content, undermining seamless Zoom call extraction.

exhibits.quote: When text is recognized and copied from images, it should be EXACTLY 1-to-1, and not like a drunk person mixing words and texts that aren't even in that order.
exhibits.argument: Review reports inaccurate scrambling of extracted text, undermining claim it can reliably extract from Zoom calls.

trials.claim: Requires macOS 10.15 Catalina and higher on Intel or Apple M1 Macs
trials.claimQuote: System requirements: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) and higher; or Intel or Apple M1 silicon macs
trials.reasoning: The vendor confirms TextSniper supports macOS Catalina and newer, matching the stated Catalina-and-higher requirement; the note about extended language support does not contradict OS support.

exhibits.quote: Which macOS versions TextSniper support? Currently we're supporting macOS Catalina and newer (extended language support)
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms Catalina+ requirement but adds language support is limited, undermining full functionality on claimed OS versions.

exhibits.quote: Currently we're supporting macOS Catalina and newer (extended language support)
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms support for macOS Catalina and newer, matching system requirement claim.
